## Summary

Describe the observable change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] I added or updated deterministic tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I ran `python -m pytest -v`.
- [ ] I did not relax tolerances or change expected outputs merely to obtain a pass.
- [ ] I reported all remaining discrepancies.
- [ ] This change contains no private or unpublished model data.
- [ ] Documentation distinguishes implemented and planned capabilities accurately.
- [ ] I understand that automated checks are not engineering approval.
